verdict: A 2D geometry built from a quantum chain's entanglement ALONE has CONSTANT curvature (maximally symmetric) only at criticality, with the central charge (c~1, cross-checking J4) read off the curvature -- measured coordinate-free via Brioschi. Gapped degenerates. The full 4th-derivative Brioschi on raw free-fermion data is noisy (the predicted 'quantum bulk'), so curvature is measured through the robust 2nd-derivative metric; entanglement -> metric -> curvature, no geometry put in by hand.
